title: Give the goal that counts Daniel's queue a place on the dashboard so it is read every evening
ask: hq/data/goals/executive.json is read by nothing because the dashboard iterates hq/data/pillars.json. Give it a home: either an executive pillar row on the dashboard side panel that renders the goal's reading (queue_state / waiting_on_you, target 0, and oldest_waiting_days), or the goal on the reader's band itself. Record the reading nightly to hq/data/history so the burn-down is a fact, not a memory. Every sentence per docs/WRITING.md.
first_action: Read load_goals and the dashboard's pillar loop in hq/server.py and hq/static/app.js; pick the smaller of the two homes and wire it.
source_message: Daniel said yes to the arrival rule (S-16) and the spawn rule (S-17) on 2026-09-20; docs/QUEUE_TO_ZERO.md §12 is the build order.
